description: This Scala source file defines the AvailableNowDataStreamWrapper class, which wraps a SparkDataStream to support Trigger.AvailableNow in Spark Structured Streaming. It overrides methods to fetch and report offsets, and logs warnings related to its activation.

classes.name: AvailableNowDataStreamWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for SparkDataStream that adds support for Trigger.AvailableNow, overriding offset methods and logging warnings.

methods.name: initialOffset
methods.description: Returns the initial offset from the delegate SparkDataStream.

methods.name: deserializeOffset
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an Offset using the delegate.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the given offset via the delegate.

methods.name: prepareForTriggerAvailableNow
methods.description: Fetches and stores the latest offset for all available data at the start of the trigger.

methods.name: getDefaultReadLimit
methods.description: Returns ReadLimit.allAvailable(), logging a warning if the source does not support it.

methods.name: latestOffset
methods.description: Returns the pre-fetched offset for the current trigger.

methods.name: reportLatestOffset
methods.description: Reports the latest offset for metrics, delegating to the underlying source or stream.
